## Q. I want it to trigger only for gifts / Super Chats

![](../../../../images/21_LimitEdit-1792763918527.webp)

1. In OmikujiBot Editor, open Comment Events > Trigger Settings.
2. Under "Trigger Condition to Apply", select "Gift".
3. Choose according to the gift conditions.
   1. The tiers follow YouTube's Super Chat colors. You cannot set a numeric amount.
   2. It does not distinguish whether a gift is "free". Only the amount is referenced.
